bullets.id: Emas sempat naik ke $4.148 pada Kamis, tertinggi sejak 20 Oktober, lalu memangkas kenaikan saat Wall Street anjlok: S&P 500 turun 4,36%, penurunan harian terdalam sejak April 2025, dan Nasdaq turun sekitar 5,5% karena aksi jual saham teknologi dan AI. Trading Economics mencatat emas di $4.068 pada Jumat pagi, turun 0,48%, tetapi masih menuju kenaikan mingguan sekitar 5%.
bullets.en: Gold rose as high as $4,148 on Thursday, its highest since 20 October, then pared gains as Wall Street sank: the S&P 500 fell 4.36%, its steepest daily drop since April 2025, and the Nasdaq lost about 5.5% in a tech and AI sell-off. Trading Economics has gold at $4,068 on Friday morning, down 0.48%, but still heading for a weekly gain of about 5%.

bullets.id: Investor memburu obligasi: yield 10 tahun AS turun ke sekitar 4,82%, terendah sejak awal September, dan peluang kenaikan bunga Fed Desember turun ke sekitar 66–69% dari sekitar 80%. Biaya tenaga kerja per unit turun 0,7% pada kuartal III. Namun Brent naik 3,9% ke $98,29 setelah serangan baru di sekitar Selat Hormuz, dan Bank of England menaikkan bunga ke 4%. Emas masih sekitar 27,5% di bawah rekor $5.608,35.
bullets.en: Investors piled into bonds: the US 10-year yield fell to about 4.82%, its lowest since early September, and the odds of a December Fed hike dropped to about 66–69% from about 80%. Unit labour costs fell 0.7% in Q3. But Brent rose 3.9% to $98.29 after renewed attacks near the Strait of Hormuz, and the Bank of England raised rates to 4%. Gold is still about 27.5% below its $5,608.35 record.

bullets.id: Kitco menyebut resistance di $4.146 lalu $4.212, dan support di $4.075 lalu $3.989; emas kini sedikit di bawah $4.075. Klaim pengangguran turun ke 189.000, di bawah perkiraan 196.000. Malam ini rilis payroll Oktober dengan perkiraan sekitar 50.000–65.000 pekerjaan dan pengangguran 4,2%; angka lemah bisa memangkas taruhan kenaikan bunga lagi.
bullets.en: Kitco puts resistance at $4,146 then $4,212, and support at $4,075 then $3,989; gold is now just below $4,075. Jobless claims fell to 189,000, below the 196,000 forecast. October payrolls are due tonight, forecast at about 50,000–65,000 jobs with 4.2% unemployment; a weak number could trim hike bets further.

bullets.id: Antam 1 gram naik Rp8.000 ke Rp2.565.000 dan buyback naik Rp13.000 ke Rp2.370.000, sehingga spread menyempit ke Rp195.000 (sekitar 7,6%). Galeri24 naik Rp39.000 ke Rp2.518.000 (buyback Rp2.370.000) dan UBS naik Rp30.000 ke Rp2.565.000 (buyback Rp2.344.000). Secara struktural, FX Leaders mencatat bank sentral membeli 321 ton pada kuartal III dan kepemilikan ETF mencapai rekor 4.256 ton.
bullets.en: Antam’s 1-gram price rose Rp8,000 to Rp2,565,000 and buyback rose Rp13,000 to Rp2,370,000, narrowing the spread to Rp195,000 (about 7.6%). Galeri24 rose Rp39,000 to Rp2,518,000 (buyback Rp2,370,000) and UBS rose Rp30,000 to Rp2,565,000 (buyback Rp2,344,000). Structurally, FX Leaders notes central banks bought 321 tonnes in Q3 and ETF holdings hit a record 4,256 tonnes.
